Two things this month.

## Faster fits

Fitting a **Weibull** to a large dataset is now roughly *twice* as fast. See the
[reference page](/reference/weibull) for the details.

## A new plot

- Probability plots now show `confidence bounds`
- They export as PNG

Thanks for using Reliafy.
